titleMs: Pendaftaran Program Khairat Kematian Bersama Masjid Al-Ilmi Dengkil
titleEn: Funeral Fund Registration with Masjid Al-Ilmi Dengkil
descMs: Musolla Al-Widad kini bernaung secara rasmi di bawah program e-Khairat Masjid Al-Ilmi Dengkil. Pendaftaran dibuka kepada semua penduduk Pangsapuri Kita Sejati bagi menjamin kebajikan urusan jenazah keluarga tercinta.
descEn: Musolla Al-Widad is officially partnered under the e-Khairat program of Masjid Al-Ilmi Dengkil. Registration is open to all Pangsapuri Kita Sejati residents to safeguard family welfare.

titleMs: Kempen Infaq Operasi & Naik Taraf Fasiliti Musolla Al-Widad
titleEn: Musolla Operations & Facility Enhancement Infaq Campaign
descMs: Sumbangan ikhlas jemaah membantu membiayai penyelenggaraan pendingin hawa, kebersihan karpet, kelengkapan wuduk, dan aktiviti pengajian komuniti melalui akaun Bank Islam atau kod QR DuitNow.
descEn: Contributions help fund air-conditioning servicing, carpet cleaning, ablution amenities, and community dakwah activities via Bank Islam or DuitNow QR.

titleMs: Kuliah Maghrib Mingguan & Kelas Bimbingan Al-Quran
titleEn: Weekly Maghrib Lectures & Quran Study Sessions
descMs: Imarahkan dewan solat bersama asatizah jemputan pada siri kuliah mingguan dan sertai kelas pengajian Al-Quran untuk seisi keluarga di Musolla Al-Widad.
descEn: Join our weekly Islamic lectures by invited teachers and attend family Quran study sessions at Musolla Al-Widad.

titleMs: Borang Cadangan Penambahbaikan & Aduan Fasiliti Penduduk
descMs: Pandangan dan cadangan anda amat berharga demi kemaslahatan bersama. Sila kemukakan cadangan penambahbaikan fasiliti atau aduan melalui Google Form rasmi musolla.
descEn: Your voice and ideas are highly valued. Please submit your suggestions or facility feedback via our official Google Form.
